One real discrepancy found: creating team labels is NOT admin-only on the backend.

minor.issue: Uses require_member, not require_admin, so member1 (team_role='member') successfully creates team labels (200 instead of the 403 stated in the review request). The Task Detail > Label panel also still shows the 'Buat label baru untuk tim' input + colour swatches to non-admins, so this is reachable from the UI. Decide whether label creation should be member-level (then update the spec) or admin-only (then add require_admin + hide the create input when myRole !== 'admin').

Known non-blocking infra quirk: ingress answers CORS preflight for an unconfigured Origin with 204/wildcard, so tests/test_security_hardening.py::test_cors_preflight_restricts_unconfigured_origin fails (expects 400). Application-level CORS with credentials + explicit origin works. No action needed.

ui_bugs.issue: Escape key does not close the task detail modal; only the X button works. The .modal-backdrop also swallows clicks on the top bar, so a user who presses Escape stays trapped in the modal.
Regular members still see the label-create input and colour swatches (matches the backend gap above). Should be hidden if label creation becomes admin-only.

issues: Due date still uses the raw browser picker (<input type="date">) instead of the shadcn calendar component used elsewhere; it renders as MM/DD/YYYY which conflicts with the Indonesian UI locale.
Label chip text is rendered in the label colour at ~22% opacity background and a very small font size, giving low contrast (e.g. light blue on light blue) and being hard to read.

Bind Escape (and keep backdrop click) to close TaskDetailModal.

critical_code_review_comments: ChatGroup.jsx: the initial `client.get(/teams/{id}/chat).then(r => setMessages(r.data))` can resolve AFTER a WS message arrives and would then wipe that message. Merge instead of replace (e.g. setMessages(prev => dedupeById([...r.data, ...prev]))) to close the remaining race.

ChatGroup.jsx: `const generation = (wsRef.current?.generation || 0) + 1` is computed once per effect run, so a socket created by the retry timer inherits the same generation - works today but is fragile; a useRef counter incremented inside connect() would be clearer.
TaskDetailModal.jsx toggleComplete falls back to `lists[0]` when no non-done list exists; if lists[0] is itself the done list the toggle silently no-ops. Guard and surface an error instead.

App.js markNotifRead/markAllNotifRead fire the PATCH without awaiting or catching - a failed request leaves the optimistic local state out of sync with the server. Add a catch that reverts or refetches.

rca_of_the_issue: Chat duplication root cause (fixed): the WS effect re-ran and the stale socket's onclose scheduled a reconnect, leaving two live sockets; the new generation token on the socket plus an id-based dedupe in onmessage (`m.some(x => x.id === data.id) ? m : [...m, data]`) now guarantees a single bubble per message. Complete-toggle root cause (fixed): toggleComplete previously always targeted the list named 'Selesai'; it now branches on list.is_done and moves back to the first non-done list, and TeamOverview/KanbanBoard read is_done instead of matching the hardcoded name. Notification collapse root cause (fixed): markNotifRead/markAllNotifRead refetched page 1; they now patch local state in place. Remaining open defect: POST /teams/{id}/labels was never switched from require_member to require_admin, so the 'member cannot create team labels' expectation is not met.
